mapper.sql: select h.arrears_id, b.batch_id, b.batch_no, b.stat_month, b.dispatch_enterprise_id, b.dispatch_enterprise_name, b.region_code, b.total_person_count, b.total_payable_amount, b.total_paid_amount, b.account_received_amount, greatest(ifnull(b.total_payable_amount, 0) - ifnull(b.total_paid_amount, 0), 0) as arrears_amount, greatest(ifnull(b.total_payable_amount, 0) - ifnull(b.account_received_amount, 0), 0) as account_gap_amount, case when b.submit_time is null then 0 else datediff(sysdate(), b.submit_time) end as overdue_days, ifnull(h.handle_status, 'pending') as handle_status, h.warning_id, h.follow_user, h.follow_time, h.next_follow_time, h.handle_result, h.remark from t_salary_batch b left join t_salary_arrears_handle h on b.batch_id = h.batch_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_salary_arrears_handle ( batch_id, warning_id, handle_status, follow_user, follow_time, next_follow_time, handle_result, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{batchId}, #{warningId}, #{handleStatus}, #{followUser}, #{followTime}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{handleResult}, #{remark}, #{followUser}, sysdate(), #{followUser}, sysdate() ) on duplicate key update warning_id = values(warning_id), handle_status = values(handle_status), follow_user = values(follow_user), follow_time = values(follow_time), next_follow_time = values(next_follow_time), handle_result = values(handle_result), remark = values(remark), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate()
